title: submit-artifact: Add submit_artifact as a public Runtime method (master §66)
description: Feature P2-17. Master §66 (Runtime Admission Gate) requires Runtime::submit_artifact as a public method. Today, Runtime::submit_direct and submit_compiled call preflight_direct_admission which calls admit_artifact_run, but the runtime never WRITES an artifact to the journal. vb_storage::admission::submit_artifact exists but is called by submit.rs (CLI) outside the runtime façade. The artifact write path is split between CLI and runtime, which is wrong: the runtime should be the single source of truth for admission. This bead: (1) adds `pub fn submit_artifact(&self, run: RunId, workflow: CompiledWorkflow) -> RuntimeResult<WorkflowDigest>` to vb_runtime/src/runtime/mod.rs; (2) internally pulls Arc<FjallJournal>, calls vb_storage::admission::submit_artifact(&fj, &workflow, current_policy), returns the digest, enqueues ShardCommand::Submit; (3) adds a Kani harness.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL expose submit_artifact as a public Runtime method, not a CLI-only path
THE SYSTEM SHALL record a WorkflowSourceRecord in the journal before admitting the run

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a caller invokes Runtime::submit_artifact(run, workflow)
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL call vb_storage::admission::submit_artifact, return Ok(WorkflowDigest), and enqueue ShardCommand::Submit

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a caller invokes Runtime::submit_direct(workflow) with the same workflow digest as a prior submit_artifact
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL be a no-op (the artifact is already in the journal)

unwanted.condition: IF submit_artifact is called with a workflow that fails the admission gate (e.g., digest mismatch)
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT enqueue ShardCommand::Submit; it must return AdmissionRejected
unwanted.because: Master §66: admission is the gate; failed admission must not reach the shard

preconditions: Runtime is constructed with a valid Arc<FjallJournal> (via new_with_journal)
Workflow is a valid CompiledWorkflow (passes gate 2 = shape)
postconditions: WorkflowSourceRecord is in the journal with the workflow_digest as the key
ShardCommand::Submit is enqueued for the run's owning shard
invariants: submit_artifact is idempotent: same workflow_digest submitted twice produces one journal entry, not two
The runtime façade is the single source of truth for admission; the CLI no longer calls vb_storage::admission::submit_artifact directly

submit_artifact_idempotent_for_same_digest: two calls with the same workflow produce one journal entry
